Definition: Oboth, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Oboth is a camp in the wilderness, one of the stations of Israel's wandering. The children of Israel pitch in Oboth in Numbers 21:10, and the itinerary of Numbers 33:43 records the same stop on the way from Punon.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God counts every camp of the wandering, and Oboth is one more proof that He led them step by step.
